topic: Data calibration and traffic metrics discussion
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several data integrity issues. First, the team discussed fixing problematic real-time data updates and clarifying that the goal is to report 'total traffic' rather than separating cluster/non-cluster traffic for standard dashboards. It was noted that fixing total traffic on the standard dashboard should update the Mall product accordingly.

Later, the discussion focused on device session calibration using staging data (`device_session_calibration_staging`). The participants confirmed that production does not see the staging calibration data. Specific instructions were given to apply new signal levels for Germany (Facility ID 7856) only to the staging environment, specifically for facilities with moved IDs.

Finally, a discussion occurred regarding unique user calculation algorithms for periods longer than one month, confirming AllUnite's ability to calculate accurate uniques using ratios and rate of decrease, even when hash keys change monthly. The team also discussed potential data discrepancies due to old firmware or lack of nearby Wi-Fi networks.
decisions: Total traffic will be the primary metric for standard dashboards, which should update the Mall product.
New signal level calibrations for Germany (Facility ID 7856) must be applied only to the staging environment using `device_session_calibration_staging`.
action_items: The speaker will provide an analysis showing the total traffic approach by the end of the day.
Calibration data for Germany needs to be uploaded/applied to staging (using provided document and facility IDs).
Confirm if calibration changes from staging need to be promoted to production.
